name: List Directory
description: List what a folder contains: sub-folders with their item count, files with size and date. Use it to find out what actually exists before reading, writing or searching — never guess a path. A relative path is inside the agent workspace, and with no arguments at all it lists the workspace itself. Machine-generated folders (.git, node_modules, __pycache__, .venv) are listed but not walked into: pass one of them as 'path' to look inside it.

path.description: Folder to list. Relative = inside the workspace. Default '.' = the workspace itself

depth.description: How many folder levels to show: 1 = only this folder (default), 2 = also one level of sub-folders, up to 5

pattern.description: Glob filter on FILE names, e.g. '*.py' or '*.md,*.txt' (comma-separated for several). Folders are always listed so you can keep navigating

limit.description: Maximum number of entries printed (default 100, max 500). When more exist the result says how many
